formation: Pictograph of a person holding onto a staff, looking to the side with his mouth open, doubtful of which direction to go. The 龰 (foot) component was added later to indicate movement, and the 牛 component was added to hint at the sound.

components.note: Depicts a person standing up, holding onto a staff, with their mouth open and looking to the side.
龰 is a component form of 止.
